name: Great Unclean One

bonuses.name: Neverending Plague
bonuses.text: The GM gains 2 Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Beloved of Nurgle
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 5 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Massive Bulk
bonuses.text: A Great Unclean One is huge and immensely difficult to kill. It has 40 Wounds.

abilities.name: Encroaching Pestilence
abilities.text: Anyone who sees a Great Unclean One must make a DN 5 Terror Test.

abilities.name: Maleficarum
abilities.text: The Great Unclean One attempts to activate any two psychic powers including Smite or a Maleficarum psychic power, treat Corruption as 7.

abilities.name: Nurglings!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. A single band of Nurglings numbering the same as the Great Unclean Ones remaining Wounds disgorges from the daemon's guts and acts immediately.

abilities.name: Disease Progression
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Great Unclean One heals 5 Wounds.

abilities.name: Noxious Discharge
abilities.text: Whenever this Threat takes a Wound, roll a d6. If you roll an Icon, a mix of virulent gases and toxic effluent spills from the Wound. The Noxious Discharge hits everytarget Engaged with the Great Unclean One. Noxious Discharge: 2 +4 ED / AP -4 / Blast (4), Inflict (Poison 4).

determination: You do not need to spend Ruin to roll 10d6 Determination. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock
note: No namesake in (aa-botuthrax-clostidia is a named Great Unclean One with other stats). Printed 'everytarget' in Noxious Discharge. Noxious Discharge has no range, so it stays REACTION text.
